bfbePlShow.label: Show

options.first: On the first page of a visit

bfbePlLimit.label: At most (s)

lives: A Bricks template type of its own, not an element: a template of type BFB Page Loader (`bfbe_page_loader`), built in the builder like any template and shown as a screen over the page wherever its Conditions say (nowhere without them), gone when the page is ready or at its limit, whichever comes first. It adds no control to any element; its four settings (`bfbePlShow`, `bfbePlLimit`, `bfbePlColor`, `bfbePlFade`: Show, At most, Screen colour, Fade) sit in the template's own settings panel.
